drivers.driver: Earnings of about $2 million on $8 million tangible assets demonstrated economic goodwill.

Paying for quality was justified even though the price exceeded Buffett's old tangible-asset anchor.
drivers.quote: My misguided caution could have scuttled a terrific purchase.
